notes.title: Mechanical Keyboard Building Simulator Survey
notes.content:
Hello Keyboard Enthusiasts!  
  
First, we'd like to express our gratitude to all those who have wishlisted the game.  
  
We kindly request a small portion of your time to share your insights. Your feedback will serve as the cornerstone for shaping gameplay mechanics, refining customization options, and much more. Feel free to unleash your creativity and offer any additional ideas that come to mind.  
  
Survey Link : https://forms.gle/3pjvDxua2siSM88S8  
  
Thank you for being a part of this exciting journey with us. Let's build something extraordinary together!

notes.title: Mechanical Keyboard Building Simulator News
notes.content:
Hello Keyboard Enthusiasts!

We are incredibly excited to share the news that multiple renowned keyboard brands have generously provided us with their stunning keyboard and component models.

Here is a list of the brands that have contributed:
- Keychron
- KBDfans
- Switchlab
- PiKeeb
- Ebastler


We are currently in discussions with even more brands, with the goal of including as many as possible in our simulator.

Here are the layouts available:
- ANSI 104
- ISO 105
- Default 60%
- ISO 60%
- JD40
- Planck
- Keycool 84
...and many more custom layouts!

Your feedback is crucial to us, so please don't hesitate to let us know which specific keyboard brands and layouts you'd like us to include. 



Warm regards,
The Mechanical Keyboard Building Simulator Team.
